findings.passage: “Pennsylvanians have the right to vote, free from interference and intimidation. This bill clarifies and reinforces that right. And clarifies that the provisions of Pennsylvania law ensuring that freedom from interference and intimidation applies to all levels of law enforcement,” Warren added.
findings.note: Quoted in his official release about House Bill 2758 (law enforcement kept 100 feet from polling places). It is about voter intimidation, not ID.
subjects: voter intimidation protection at polling places

findings.note: The release lists him as a co-sponsor of House Bill 2758, which amends the Election Code to bar law enforcement from being within 100 feet of a polling location on Election Day. Not about ID.
